mutants.description: faulting a service leaves its locks held
mutants.witness:
theorem witness_zombie_lock : ¬ type_of% @supervisor_no_zombie_lock_on_restart := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h ({ services := fun _ => ⟨.running, true, 3, 0⟩, lockOwner := fun _ => some 0 } : SupervisorState) 0
  dsimp only at h0
  have h1 := h0.1 0
  revert h1
  decide

mutants.description: restart does not advance the token generation
mutants.witness:
theorem witness_token_not_fresh : ¬ type_of% @supervisor_restart_never_leaks_prior_token := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h ({ services := fun _ => ⟨.running, true, 3, 0⟩, lockOwner := fun _ => some 0 } : SupervisorState) 0 rfl
  simp [SupervisorState.faultService, SupervisorState.restartService, SupervisorState.validateToken] at h0

mutants.description: restart with a revoked capability leaves the service running

theorem witness_revoked_runs : ¬ type_of% @supervisor_revoked_cap_rejects_restart := by

  have h0 := h ({ services := fun _ => ⟨.faulted, false, 3, 3⟩, lockOwner := fun _ => none } : SupervisorState) 0 rfl
  simp [SupervisorState.restartService] at h0
